scope: Batch 4: the wake skill, the Autonomous run playbook, an unattended path in Hillclimb, and Bug fix's long hunt and unattended answer. No report and no upstream trait rows (README 4a's playbook exemption).
method: Owner rulings of 2026-11-04 on the batch's six questions, all as recommended; ruling 12 amended, recorded in the map and as a dated S7 row in unit-kinds.

subject: ours:wake
why: New skill, owner rulings of 2026-11-04 amending ruling 12: a card holding one run's limits, attempts, closed state and checkpoint for any run with a stated limit, plus one closing timer at the deadline for a stated unattended run. Waiting on a command needs none of it. Two callers, Autonomous run and Hillclimb, or a person asking; model-invocable because they call it through the platform. A run the engine owns uses the engine's monitor.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/autonomous-run.md
why: New playbook, owner rulings of 2026-11-04. Steps: (1) the exit predicate and limits; (2) an artifact directory outside the tree on every path, the isolation and environment proof when stated unattended, then decision-trail open through step 6; (3) wake when a limit or unattended words apply; (4) one iteration with the change checks, a saved patch for each discard, the discard before the row and the row before the checkpoint; (5) the hold, with the pivot and dead-end test; (6) closing and closeout on every exit; (7) land on an attended Met only.

subject: cursor_plugins:playbook:pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/autonomous-run
why: Map 2.16 and the owner rulings of 2026-11-04: the exit-predicate loop, a playbook by a named exception to the composite test, delivering the map's adaptation.

modifications: Mid-run discoveries follow the scope rule (map 7.1, item 1): in scope only when the predicate cannot be met without the fix or the request names it; the rest go to a linked bead or the reply, unfixed.
land runs once, at the end, on an attended Met only.
A fixed stop order: predicate met, a limit, a dead end. A limit stops new work even with an idea left, and a dead end has a stated test.
A stated unattended run is isolated in its own worktree, with no delegated writer, and leaves a patch and the folder aside; a discarded candidate is saved as a patch on every path.
deliberately_dropped: Cursor's /loop: a tool name in a playbook, against ruling 12's point that playbooks name the outcome. revisit_when: never for the name; wake's vendor files hold the tools.
The watcher subagent: a bounded background command and its completion notice replace it, and no way to wait gives Stopped, waiting. revisit_when: real sessions show notices do not arrive.

The heartbeat and its use as a fallback: one closing timer replaces it; a lost notice waits for the deadline, and no timer means no reply is promised. revisit_when: a real night shows runs stopping early.
AskQuestion: not a tool every runtime has, and nobody answers an unattended run; an open question goes to the trail and the reply.
Per-iteration commits: the loop commits nothing, so a discard stays simple and land keeps its authority gate.
Out-of-band pull requests: publishing needs authority, and out-of-scope discoveries stay unfixed.
'Do not park for the human': a step needing authority the request did not give is not taken.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/hillclimb.md
why: An unattended path, owner rulings of 2026-11-04. The trigger and hillclimb#8's condition change; attended-only-gate leaves and stated-unattended-gate joins. hillclimb#1 gains the target from the request and the limits; hillclimb#2 gains the wake call, climb-checkpoint, the environment proof and the waiting sentence; hillclimb#3's columns gain seq, tree, index and value; hillclimb#4 gains the waiting sentence and row-then-checkpoint, and its delegation is attended only; hillclimb#5 gets a stop order and limit-bounded-hold; hillclimb#7 gains the closing return and the closeout that leaves work aside. A terminal stop writes a marker first, so recovery never touches its tree. The unattended technique sits in the reference hillclimb/unattended.md, loaded by hillclimb#2 and hillclimb#7 only when the run is stated unattended. An attended climb with no limit keeps its loop, with no card.

subject: cursor_plugins:playbook:pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/hillclimb
why: Owner rulings of 2026-11-04: delivers the unattended branch batch 2 left out, and corrects two batch 2 lines (undo is not atomic; bringing back is attended only).

modifications: The loop commits nothing; one land at the end, after closeout, passing kept attempts in order, and attempts that overlap or depend on each other can collapse into one commit, as the reply says (MS6, owner ruling Q2).
Undo is a reverse patch between tree snapshots through hillclimb/attempt.py, proved first and verified, not atomic, with no history or index movement, so another writer's edits survive (MS6).
A climb needing isolation runs in one detached worktree brought back at closeout when attended; a stated unattended climb keeps its worktree and patch (MS6).
A demonstrated simplification may stay, logged as no speedup (critic F6); the columns are a caller's on decision-trail's fixed ones.
The card and closing timer come from wake, called whole (map 802's remedy for the borrow), never the Autonomous run playbook, and the stop rule stays Hillclimb's.
deliberately_dropped: Parallel attempts, one worktree per hypothesis: measurement stays serial, so fan-out saves only edit time and costs the undo recipe's risk (N10). revisit_when: editing time dominates a climb and measurement can stay serial.
One commit per accepted fix: land runs once at the end (MS6, owner ruling Q2). revisit_when: the owner rules per-attempt commits.
The per-role model line; delegation follows the local rule and roster.
The Opening a PR run; land stops at commits. revisit_when: we adopt a PR flow with CI.
Delegated writers on the unattended path: T3 cannot bind the climb worktree. revisit_when: a supported binding.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/bug-fix.md
why: Owner ruling of 2026-11-04: a stated unattended request is Not started for now, since the two-failure stop counts failed fixes and not diagnosis. The playbook gains stated-unattended-gate and unattended-not-started; bug-fix#2 gains long-hunt-test and the waiting sentence, and its provisional stop names what is outstanding. No card, no timer, no trail. The gate and every other step are unchanged.

subject: cursor_plugins:playbook:pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/bug-fix
why: Owner rulings of 2026-11-04: the long hunt needs no wake, and wake has two callers.

modifications: Reproducing and diagnosing call systematic-debugging whole, now diagnosis-only (H9, B3).
A fix waits on a confirmed cause, and removes a failed attempt's own changes.
The rerun is of the original scenario as reported; an inconclusive rerun is not a pass.
Delegation follows the local rule instead of being mandatory (report 4.3).
Running the command replaces the control skills for our CLI and Python surfaces.
A hunt is long only by a shipped test, its next evidence unable to arrive within one foreground command; a stubborn hunt with something to run now keeps running.
deliberately_dropped: Design first through an architect skill (not in the pilot; batch 1's design-only sketch branch of codebase-design supplies it).
Committing the red test first, which needs commit authority (B8).
Opening a PR (batch 1's land skill supplies the closeout; the PR flow stays deferred).
Cursor /loop for a long hunt: a bounded background command and its notice replace it, with no wake, departing from ruling 12's callers; the per-role model line.

subject: ours:mvp-mode
why: A router line for Autonomous run, and Hillclimb's line now says attended, or unattended when the request says so. No row for wake: a calling playbook names it and its description meets a person's request. Bug fix's line is unchanged. The catalog regenerates for the new skill.
